study_line: A461 (execution ledger round A468, stage 3, amended)
amends: A461_G5_PATCHING_PROTOCOL_V1 (9684e37) per pre-patching audit afbebb4 (P0-2: host old-arm has no appended span; P0-1: scene exclusion fixed in construction V2)
purpose: Exploratory single-donor bidirectional activation patching on SCHEMA-VALID appended spans only: the donor's recognized-conflict appended vote (new arm) against failing scenes' SA duplicate-vote appended arms (same construction family, appended event exists, Gold=false, token-matched 34/36 in V2).

host_redefinition.old_design_invalid: patching a host OLD arm's tail positions - the old arm has no appended vote, so the 'appended span' does not exist there (audit P0-2)
host_redefinition.v2_host: each failing scene's SA arm (the scene's own appended duplicate-vote event: same event count as its treatment arm, appended span exists at [state_len_sa - w, state_len_sa), C read false, gold false)

donor: G5 V2 qualified donor (pair 433890d1..., wait cell): old C=false, new C=true (recognized), SA C=false
targets: 10 failing scenes (5 wait + 5 accept, deterministic lowest-row_id) from the V2 construction; each contributes its SA arm as the patch host and its treatment arm as the suppression source

intervention.span_definition_v2: per scene, the appended-event span = [state_len - w, state_len) of that arm's rendered state, where w = state growth vs the scene's old arm (33/34); measured per arm by rerender (G4 G0C anchor method)
intervention.direction_A_restoration: patch host SA-arm row at its appended span with the donor NEW-arm appended-span states, at backbone layer outputs L in {3,7,11,15,19,23}: does the host C read flip toward true?
intervention.direction_B_suppression: patch donor NEW-arm row at its appended span with each failing scene's TREATMENT-arm appended-span states: does the donor C read flip away from true?
intervention.alignment: linear index map over span width differences, recorded per pair; single-row forwards only (hybrid architecture)

controls: identity: host SA arm patched with its own span states (2 hosts, layer 11) must reproduce the unpatched read
SA-sham cross: donor SA-arm span (non-recognized vote) patched into host SA arm (10 hosts x 6 layers) - does a non-conflict appended representation fail to restore (it should)
random-token: position-permuted donor span states (5 hosts x 6 layers)
off-target metrics: quorum and action heads on every patched forward

budget.cap: each sub-stage <= 128; admission receipts with frozen compositions precede execution
budget.authorization: user standing authorization series 2026-10-25 (white-box mechanism goal)

analysis_preregistered: restoration: per host x layer signed C-margin change vs host baseline; flip count; must exceed SA-sham cross and random-token controls at the same layers for a causal claim
suppression: donor C-margin change per target x layer
off-target flip rates; layer profile reported for all layers without selection
single-donor exploratory case study label throughout
submission_for_blind_review: V2 protocol + exclusion erratum + V2 search results submitted together; execution only after blind review verdict
archive: research/rounds/A461_G5_DONOR_RESOLUTION_AND_PATCHING/ (V2 artifacts under G0D_CONS_V2/G1S_V2 naming, PATCHING_V2_REAL/ for execution)
